defects_audited_and_closed.root_cause: Previously fell back to a hardcoded source-code secret when key_id was missing in signing_key_registry._keys and accessed _keys directly without checking caller signing authority or key purpose permissions.
defects_audited_and_closed.remediation: Removed hardcoded fallback secret and direct _keys access completely. Delegated signing exclusively to signing_key_registry.sign_with_authority(..., required_purpose=KEY_PURPOSE_REPLICATION_ATTESTATION, authority_context=authority_context). Rejected caller-supplied secrets, keys, and authorization booleans.

defects_audited_and_closed.root_cause: Previously registered cbe-data-authority-2026-v1, cbe-attestation-2026-v1, and cbe-attestation-2025-revoked with hardcoded literal secrets in signing_key_registry._keys at import time.
defects_audited_and_closed.remediation: Removed all hardcoded secret literals and _keys accesses from scientific_readiness.py. Permanently revoked cbe-attestation-2026-v1, cbe-data-authority-2026-v1, and cbe-attestation-2025-revoked in SigningKeyRegistry.DEFAULT_REVOKED_KEY_IDS.

defects_audited_and_closed.root_cause: Ordinary research application runtime and public HTTP APIs needed explicit fail-closed separation between verification (permitted) and signing (prohibited).
defects_audited_and_closed.remediation: Enforced CBE_RUNTIME_SIGNING_MODE=VERIFICATION_ONLY by default, added public_api_request_guard(), and rejected all API signing or caller-flag escalation attempts with HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN.
